subs: Your Honor, would the court be willing to grant me a short bathroom break?
- Can't it wait? - Yes, it can.
But I've heard that if you hold it, it can damage the prostate gland,
making it very difficult to get an erection!
- Is that true? - It has to be.
Well, in that case, I better take a little break myself.
But you get back here immediately so we can finish this.
How am I going to get out of this?
Think. Think.
Think!
What the hell are you doing?
I'm kicking my ass! Do you mind?
I found him like this in the bathroom, Your Honor.
Somebody beat the hell out of him.
- Who did this? - A madman, Your Honor!

us.en: He grins,
leaps over the bar
and scurries out of the courtroom.
Dana leans over
and whispers to Mr. Cole.
In a bathroom, Fletcher uses a urinal.
us.zh_draft: 廁所裡，佛萊契站在小便斗前。
us.zh: 廁所裡，佛萊契站在小便斗前。

us.en: He bangs his forehead against the wall.
He turns
and addresses his reflection in a mirror.
He zips his pants
and runs to the mirror.
He punches himself in the face.
us.zh_draft: 他朝自己臉上揍了一拳。
us.zh: 他朝自己臉上揍了一拳。

us.en: He pumps liquid soap into his hands,
then dabs it into his eyes.
A man enters the restroom
and jumps at the sight of Fletcher.
Fletcher tears at his clothes,
us.zh_draft: 佛萊契撕扯自己的衣服，
us.zh: 佛萊契撕扯自己的衣服，

us.en: then wriggles around,
pulling his hair.
Fletcher kicks out
and slams his knee into a radiator.
The man's jaw drops.
Fletcher falls to the ground.
Fletcher smacks the top off a garbage can
us.zh_draft: 佛萊契拍掉垃圾桶的蓋子，
us.zh: 佛萊契拍掉垃圾桶的蓋子，

us.en: and turns it upside down,
dumping the trash all over himself.
With a bloody nose, Fletcher rolls across the floor
us.zh_draft: 佛萊契鼻子流血，在地上打滾，
us.zh: 佛萊契鼻子流血，在地上打滾，

us.en: and hits his head inside of a toilet.
He lifts the lid
and places his head beneath it.
He slams the lid into his head over and over.
us.zh_draft: 他用蓋子一次又一次砸自己的頭。
us.zh: 他用蓋子一次又一次砸自己的頭。

us.en: He squishes his head beneath the lid.
us.zh_draft: 他用蓋子夾住自己的頭。
us.zh: 他用蓋子夾住自己的頭。

us.en: The man continues watching, startled.
Fletcher stumbles up
and stomps on his own foot.
He staggers toward the man.
The man staggers backward toward the door
and shakes his head.
Fletcher slams himself into the wall,
as the man stumbles out of the room.
us.zh_draft: 男子跌跌撞撞逃出廁所。
us.zh: 男子跌跌撞撞逃出廁所。

us.en: Fletcher launches his whole body at the wall,
us.zh_draft: 佛萊契整個人飛撲撞向牆壁，
us.zh: 佛萊契整個人飛撲撞向牆壁，

us.en: then falls onto his back, unconscious.
In the courtroom, Mrs. Cole powders her face.
us.zh_draft: 法庭裡，柯爾太太在補粉。
us.zh: 法庭裡，柯爾太太在補粉。

us.en: Judge Stevens and Dana check their watches.
us.zh_draft: 史蒂文斯法官和黛娜看了看手錶。
us.zh: 史蒂文斯法官和黛娜看了看手錶。

us.en: Mr. Cole yawns.
A court officer enters, supporting a bloodied and bedraggled Fletcher.
us.zh_draft: 一名法警走進來，扶著滿身是血、狼狽不堪的佛萊契。
us.zh: 一名法警走進來，扶著滿身是血、狼狽不堪的佛萊契。

uk.en: Fletcher leaps over a low-lying wooden gate
uk.zh_draft: 佛萊契跳過矮木門，
uk.zh: 佛萊契跳過矮木門，

uk.en: and dashes out of the courtroom to the bemused muttering of the assembled public.
uk.zh_draft: 衝出法庭，旁聽席一陣困惑的竊竊私語。
uk.zh: 衝出法庭，旁聽席一陣困惑的竊竊私語。

uk.en: In the bathroom, he leans forward against a urinal
uk.zh_draft: 廁所裡，他身體前傾靠在小便斗上，
uk.zh: 廁所裡，他身體前傾靠在小便斗上，

uk.en: and stares up at the high ceiling.
uk.zh_draft: 抬頭盯著高高的天花板。
uk.zh: 抬頭盯著高高的天花板。

uk.en: Banging his head on the marbled wall.
uk.zh_draft: 用頭撞大理石牆。
uk.zh: 用頭撞大理石牆。

uk.en: Fletcher zips up his fly,
uk.zh_draft: 佛萊契拉上拉鍊，
uk.zh: 佛萊契拉上拉鍊，

uk.en: hurries across to the mirror
uk.zh_draft: 快步走到鏡子前，
uk.zh: 快步走到鏡子前，

uk.en: and starts hitting himself around the face.
uk.zh_draft: 開始往自己臉上猛打。
uk.zh: 開始往自己臉上猛打。

uk.en: Next, he rubs liquid soap from a dispenser into both his eyes.
uk.zh_draft: 接著，他從給皂機擠出洗手乳，抹進雙眼。
uk.zh: 接著，他從給皂機擠出洗手乳，抹進雙眼。

uk.en: A flabbergasted man watches
uk.zh_draft: 一名男子目瞪口呆地看著
uk.zh: 一名男子目瞪口呆地看著

uk.en: as Fletcher tears at the sleeves of his suit,
uk.zh_draft: 佛萊契撕扯西裝袖子，
uk.zh: 佛萊契撕扯西裝袖子，

uk.en: writhes at his hair
uk.zh_draft: 扭扯頭髮，
uk.zh: 扭扯頭髮，

uk.en: and smacks his knee against a radiator.
uk.zh_draft: 膝蓋撞上暖氣片。
uk.zh: 膝蓋撞上暖氣片。

uk.en: Next, he knocks the swivel top off a bin
uk.zh_draft: 接著，他打掉垃圾桶的翻蓋，
uk.zh: 接著，他打掉垃圾桶的翻蓋，

uk.en: and empties all the used paper hand towels over his head.
uk.zh_draft: 把用過的擦手紙全倒在自己頭上。
uk.zh: 把用過的擦手紙全倒在自己頭上。

uk.en: He rolls across the floor
uk.zh_draft: 他在地上打滾，
uk.zh: 他在地上打滾，

uk.en: and hits his head against a toilet bowl,
uk.zh_draft: 頭撞上馬桶，
uk.zh: 頭撞上馬桶，

uk.en: before slamming down the wooden toilet seat again and again on the side of his rubbery face.
uk.zh_draft: 再用木製馬桶座一次次砸向自己那張橡皮般的臉。
uk.zh: 再用木製馬桶座一次次砸向自己那張橡皮般的臉。

uk.en: Finally, to the astonishment of the transfixed onlooker, he emerges from the cubicle
uk.zh_draft: 最後，在看傻了的男子驚愕注視下，他從隔間走出來，
uk.zh: 最後，在看傻了的男子驚愕注視下，他從隔間走出來，

uk.en: and stamps on his own foot.
uk.zh_draft: 往自己腳上一踩。
uk.zh: 往自己腳上一踩。

uk.en: As the man makes a speedy exit, Fletcher drags himself by the tie
uk.zh_draft: 男子飛快離開，佛萊契扯著自己的領帶，
uk.zh: 男子飛快離開，佛萊契扯著自己的領帶，

uk.en: and hurls himself repeatedly against the wall.
uk.zh_draft: 一次次把自己摔向牆壁。
uk.zh: 一次次把自己摔向牆壁。

uk.en: With one final thwack, he falls unconscious on the floor.
uk.zh_draft: 最後砰的一聲，他倒在地上昏了過去。
uk.zh: 最後砰的一聲，他倒在地上昏了過去。

uk.en: Back in the courtroom, Mrs. Cole sits powdering her nose
uk.zh_draft: 回到法庭，柯爾太太坐著在鼻子上補粉，
uk.zh: 回到法庭，柯爾太太坐著在鼻子上補粉，

uk.en: while the judge and Counsel Appleton impatiently look at their watches.
uk.zh_draft: 法官和艾波頓律師不耐煩地看著手錶。
uk.zh: 法官和艾波頓律師不耐煩地看著手錶。

uk.en: Suddenly, a security guard drags in a battered looking Fletcher.
uk.zh_draft: 突然，一名警衛拖著遍體鱗傷的佛萊契進來。
uk.zh: 突然，一名警衛拖著遍體鱗傷的佛萊契進來。

us.en: The SUV cruises a forest road.
us.zh_draft: 休旅車行駛在林間道路上。
us.zh: 休旅車行駛在林間道路上。

us.en: Pulling out, the motorcycle kicks up gravel.
As Martin struggles to drive, the SUV swerves.
us.zh_draft: 馬汀吃力地駕駛，休旅車左右打滑。
us.zh: 馬汀吃力地駕駛，休旅車左右打滑。

us.en: Salander catches air,
then races down the forest road
us.zh_draft: 接著在林間道路上疾馳，
us.zh: 接著在林間道路上疾馳，

us.en: and rounds a bend.
Her lone headlight shines through Martin's back window.
us.zh_draft: 她唯一的車燈照進馬汀的後車窗。
us.zh: 她唯一的車燈照進馬汀的後車窗。

us.en: Her view finds the SUV rounding a bend.
us.zh_draft: 她看見休旅車轉過彎道。
us.zh: 她看見休旅車轉過彎道。

us.en: Martin checks his rear view mirror.
Salander hunches over her bike's handlebars.
us.zh_draft: 莎蘭德伏身在機車把手上。
us.zh: 莎蘭德伏身在機車把手上。

us.en: The vehicles race along the forest road, flanked by tall, thin trees.
us.zh_draft: 兩輛車在林間道路上競速，兩旁是高瘦的樹木。
us.zh: 兩輛車在林間道路上競速，兩旁是高瘦的樹木。

us.en: Now the motorcycle gains on the SUV, jouncing in the cold rushing air.
us.zh_draft: 機車逐漸逼近休旅車，在呼嘯的冷風中顛簸。
us.zh: 機車逐漸逼近休旅車，在呼嘯的冷風中顛簸。

us.en: Martin checks his rear view again.
us.zh_draft: 馬汀又看了一眼後照鏡。
us.zh: 馬汀又看了一眼後照鏡。

us.en: She follows him down a hill, peering ahead with a determined gaze.
us.zh_draft: 她跟著他衝下山坡，眼神堅定地盯著前方。
us.zh: 她跟著他衝下山坡，眼神堅定地盯著前方。

us.en: As they reach the bridge, Salander rides up close.
us.zh_draft: 到了橋上，莎蘭德緊跟上去。
us.zh: 到了橋上，莎蘭德緊跟上去。

us.en: Martin spots her in his side mirror,
us.zh_draft: 馬汀從側後照鏡看見她，
us.zh: 馬汀從側後照鏡看見她，

us.en: then cuts her off before she can pass.
us.zh_draft: 在她超車前切過去擋住她。
us.zh: 在她超車前切過去擋住她。

us.en: She tries the other side,
but he blocks her way.
Nearing the end of the bridge, she fakes him out
us.zh_draft: 快到橋尾時，她虛晃一招，
us.zh: 快到橋尾時，她虛晃一招，

us.en: and as his SUV grazes the right hand railing, Salander races ahead on his left.
us.zh_draft: 休旅車擦過右側護欄，莎蘭德從他左側衝到前面。
us.zh: 休旅車擦過右側護欄，莎蘭德從他左側衝到前面。

us.en: She veers across his path.
He swerves through a wooden fence,
bangs off a low stone wall
and goes airborne.
As Salander skids off her bike, Martin's SUV grinds on its side into a fuel tank outside the grocery store.
us.zh_draft: 莎蘭德從機車上滑落，馬汀的休旅車側翻，擦地撞上雜貨店外的油槽。
us.zh: 莎蘭德從機車上滑落，馬汀的休旅車側翻，擦地撞上雜貨店外的油槽。

us.en: Salander approaches.
Thick smoke rises from the wreck.
Approaching the vehicle, Salander removes the gun from her waistband
us.zh_draft: 莎蘭德走向車子，從腰間掏出槍，
us.zh: 莎蘭德走向車子，從腰間掏出槍，

us.en: and holds it at her side.
Inside the SUV, Martin watches through the windshield.
us.zh_draft: 休旅車裡，馬汀透過擋風玻璃看著。
us.zh: 休旅車裡，馬汀透過擋風玻璃看著。

us.en: Still about 50 yards away, Salander continues her march toward the wreck through a gentle snowfall.
us.zh_draft: 莎蘭德在約五十碼外，冒著細雪繼續朝殘骸走去。
us.zh: 莎蘭德在約五十碼外，冒著細雪繼續朝殘骸走去。

us.en: Martin watches her, his face bloody.
The pale woman's gaze remains fixed on him.
us.zh_draft: 蒼白的女子目光緊盯著他。
us.zh: 蒼白的女子目光緊盯著他。

us.en: He sees a spark.
A fiery explosion erupts, rising over 50 feet high.
us.zh_draft: 一陣爆炸，火焰竄起超過五十英尺高。
us.zh: 一陣爆炸，火焰竄起超過五十英尺高。

us.en: Salander steps back and watches the SUV burn.
us.zh_draft: 莎蘭德往後退，看著休旅車燃燒。
us.zh: 莎蘭德往後退，看著休旅車燃燒。

us.en: The flames reach into the night sky.
Our view swings around behind the young woman, the burning wreck now visible over her shoulder.
us.zh_draft: 鏡頭轉到年輕女子身後，越過她的肩膀可見燃燒的殘骸。
us.zh: 鏡頭轉到年輕女子身後，越過她的肩膀可見燃燒的殘骸。

us.en: She looks at the gun,
releases its trigger,
then turns away.
She marches back to her motorcycle.
Fade to black.

uk.en: The motorcycle starts to gain ground on the Range Rover.
uk.zh_draft: 機車開始追近荒原路華。
uk.zh: 機車開始追近荒原路華。

uk.en: Martin sees its headlights appear in his rear view mirror.
uk.zh_draft: 馬汀看見後照鏡裡出現機車的車燈。
uk.zh: 馬汀看見後照鏡裡出現機車的車燈。

uk.en: Lisbeth guns the bike’s engine, shrinking the gap between her and the car.
uk.zh_draft: 莉絲貝催緊油門，拉近與車子的距離。
uk.zh: 莉絲貝催緊油門，拉近與車子的距離。

uk.en: As they approached the bridge, she's right on Martin's tail.
uk.zh_draft: 接近橋時，她緊咬在馬汀車後。
uk.zh: 接近橋時，她緊咬在馬汀車後。

uk.en: He sees her try to come alongside him
uk.zh_draft: 他看見她想從旁邊超上來，
uk.zh: 他看見她想從旁邊超上來，

uk.en: and swerves to block her path.
uk.zh_draft: 便急轉擋住她。
uk.zh: 便急轉擋住她。

uk.en: She makes another attempt
uk.zh_draft: 她再試一次，
uk.zh: 她再試一次，

uk.en: and he slews back across the bridge.
uk.zh_draft: 他又甩回橋的另一側。
uk.zh: 他又甩回橋的另一側。

uk.en: The Range Rover’s gyrations become more violent as he tries to stop her passing
uk.zh_draft: 為了不讓她超車，荒原路華甩動得越來越劇烈，
uk.zh: 為了不讓她超車，荒原路華甩動得越來越劇烈，

uk.en: and the back clips the bridge.
uk.zh_draft: 車尾擦撞橋身。
uk.zh: 車尾擦撞橋身。

uk.en: Lisbeth guns her engine and streaks through on Martin's left hand side.
uk.zh_draft: 莉絲貝猛催油門，從馬汀左側疾衝而過。
uk.zh: 莉絲貝猛催油門，從馬汀左側疾衝而過。

uk.en: He loses control as he comes off the end of the bridge
uk.zh_draft: 他駛離橋尾時失控，
uk.zh: 他駛離橋尾時失控，

uk.en: and overturns the car.
uk.zh_draft: 車子翻覆。
uk.zh: 車子翻覆。

uk.en: It comes to rest on its side in the road.
uk.zh_draft: 車子側躺在路中央。
uk.zh: 車子側躺在路中央。

uk.en: Lisbeth comes to a skidding halt, dropping the bike in the process.
uk.zh_draft: 莉絲貝滑行急停，機車也倒在地上。
uk.zh: 莉絲貝滑行急停，機車也倒在地上。

uk.en: She takes a deep breath
uk.zh_draft: 她深吸一口氣，
uk.zh: 她深吸一口氣，

uk.en: and walks towards the stricken Range Rover as smoke billows from it.
uk.zh_draft: 走向冒著濃煙的荒原路華。
uk.zh: 走向冒著濃煙的荒原路華。

uk.en: She takes the pistol from her pocket
uk.zh_draft: 她從口袋掏出手槍，
uk.zh: 她從口袋掏出手槍，

uk.en: and cocks it.
uk.zh_draft: 扳起擊錘。
uk.zh: 扳起擊錘。

uk.en: Trapped inside the vehicle, Martin looks fearfully through the windscreen
uk.zh_draft: 受困車內的馬汀驚恐地望向擋風玻璃外，
uk.zh: 受困車內的馬汀驚恐地望向擋風玻璃外，

uk.en: as Lisbeth walks towards him.
uk.zh_draft: 莉絲貝正朝他走來。
uk.zh: 莉絲貝正朝他走來。

uk.en: Something shorts out under the bonnet, igniting spilled fuel, and the Range Rover is engulfed in a massive fireball.
uk.zh_draft: 引擎蓋下某處短路，點燃外洩的汽油，荒原路華被巨大火球吞沒。
uk.zh: 引擎蓋下某處短路，點燃外洩的汽油，荒原路華被巨大火球吞沒。

uk.en: Lisbeth stops in her tracks and watches as the car and Martin are incinerated in front of her.
uk.zh_draft: 莉絲貝停下腳步，看著車子和馬汀在眼前燒成灰燼。
uk.zh: 莉絲貝停下腳步，看著車子和馬汀在眼前燒成灰燼。

uk.en: She uncocks the pistol and walks back to her bike.
uk.zh_draft: 她放下擊錘，走回機車。
uk.zh: 她放下擊錘，走回機車。

uk.en: The screen fades to black.
uk.zh_draft: 畫面淡出至全黑。
uk.zh: 畫面淡出至全黑。

subs: Not all of us are human.
Just put him over there on the couch.
Help! Help me!
- My God! - Get it off him!
What the fuck is this shit, man?
Carter, Carter!
Carter, burn it, man!
There's something wrong with it! Hold on!
Goddamn it, Carter, burn it!
Look out! Fuck!
Adam!
- Shit! - Carter, take it!
Carter!
There's something wrong with the pressure.
Put some air in the pipe.
Watch out!
Carter!
We gotta get the air up.
No.
No.
No.
God!
No, God!
Carter!
No! No!

us.en: Kate takes a seat.
As Jonas and Colin help Edvard around the pool table, the wounded man's left arm detaches
us.zh_draft: 喬納斯和柯林扶著艾德華繞過撞球桌時，傷者的左臂脫落，
us.zh: 喬納斯和柯林扶著艾德華繞過撞球桌時，傷者的左臂脫落，

us.en: and slides out his sleeve to reveal tentacles.
It crawls up Jonas's shoulder.
He grabs at the alien limb as it reaches for his face.
us.zh_draft: 異形肢體伸向他的臉，他一把抓住。
us.zh: 異形肢體伸向他的臉，他一把抓住。

us.en: The others recoil.
Jonas backs into a shelf.
A mouth within the bloody stump attaches itself to Jonas's mouth,
us.zh_draft: 血淋淋斷肢裡的一張嘴吸住喬納斯的嘴，
us.zh: 血淋淋斷肢裡的一張嘴吸住喬納斯的嘴，

us.en: and the forearm ripples as if feeding him.
us.zh_draft: 前臂一陣蠕動，像在餵他東西。
us.zh: 前臂一陣蠕動，像在餵他東西。

us.en: A bulge pokes up from underneath Edvard's sweater
us.zh_draft: 艾德華的毛衣底下鼓起一團，
us.zh: 艾德華的毛衣底下鼓起一團，

us.en: as his body convulses on the floor.
Carter struggles with his flamethrower.
us.zh_draft: 卡特手忙腳亂地弄火焰噴射器。
us.zh: 卡特手忙腳亂地弄火焰噴射器。

us.en: A long tentacle emerges from Edvard's chest,
us.zh_draft: 一條長觸手從艾德華胸口竄出，
us.zh: 一條長觸手從艾德華胸口竄出，

us.en: snaps at the blond research assistant,
then whips past Kate and Carter
and takes out the pool table lamp.
He dodges toward an open door,
but stumbles.
The tentacle pierces his chest,
then retracts, spilling a gush of blood.
us.zh_draft: 隨即抽回，鮮血噴湧而出。
us.zh: 隨即抽回，鮮血噴湧而出。

us.en: Sander escapes.
The two pilots flip the pool table on its side.
us.zh_draft: 兩名機師把撞球桌翻倒立起。
us.zh: 兩名機師把撞球桌翻倒立起。

us.en: The tentacle whips around the room.
us.zh_draft: 觸手在房間裡四處揮舞。
us.zh: 觸手在房間裡四處揮舞。

us.en: It breaks through the pool table.
Jameson stands up
and shoots Edvard,
but the tentacle pierces his chest.
us.zh_draft: 但觸手刺穿了他的胸口。
us.zh: 但觸手刺穿了他的胸口。

us.en: Kate and his copilot look on
us.zh_draft: 凱特和他的副機師眼睜睜看著
us.zh: 凱特和他的副機師眼睜睜看著

us.en: as he slides down to the floor.
Carter takes off his flamethrower tank.
us.zh_draft: 卡特卸下火焰噴射器的燃料罐。
us.zh: 卡特卸下火焰噴射器的燃料罐。

us.en: He tends to Jameson
while Kate works on the flamethrower.
us.zh_draft: 凱特則忙著修火焰噴射器。
us.zh: 凱特則忙著修火焰噴射器。

us.en: Edvard's face tilts backwards, eyeing Adam.
us.zh_draft: 艾德華的臉往後仰，盯著亞當。
us.zh: 艾德華的臉往後仰，盯著亞當。

us.en: The Norwegian's body arches
us.zh_draft: 這名挪威人的身體向上弓起，
us.zh: 這名挪威人的身體向上弓起，

us.en: and his sweater rips open.
His right arm wrenches free from his sleeve
us.zh_draft: 他的右臂從袖子裡掙脫，
us.zh: 他的右臂從袖子裡掙脫，

us.en: and skitters off on eight legs like a crab.
us.zh_draft: 像螃蟹一樣用八隻腳竄走。
us.zh: 像螃蟹一樣用八隻腳竄走。

us.en: Thick, sinewy limbs, slick with blood, grow from Edvard's bare chest
us.zh_draft: 沾滿鮮血、粗壯筋肉般的肢體從艾德華赤裸的胸口長出，
us.zh: 沾滿鮮血、粗壯筋肉般的肢體從艾德華赤裸的胸口長出，

us.en: and lift his back up off the floor.
Adam tries to scoot away,
but the spider-like monstrosity crawls on top of him.
us.zh_draft: 但那隻蜘蛛般的怪物爬到他身上。
us.zh: 但那隻蜘蛛般的怪物爬到他身上。

us.en: Kate releases pressure from a valve.
The creature pins Adam down.
He watches in horror as the alien's neck elongates.
us.zh_draft: 他驚恐地看著異形的脖子越伸越長。
us.zh: 他驚恐地看著異形的脖子越伸越長。

us.en: Edvard's bearded face rolls against Adam's
us.zh_draft: 艾德華留著鬍子的臉貼上亞當的臉，
us.zh: 艾德華留著鬍子的臉貼上亞當的臉，

us.en: and their flesh fuses together.
us.zh_draft: 兩人的血肉融合在一起。
us.zh: 兩人的血肉融合在一起。

us.en: Now conjoined at the cheek, they share an agonised scream.
us.zh_draft: 臉頰相連的兩人一起痛苦尖叫。
us.zh: 臉頰相連的兩人一起痛苦尖叫。

us.en: With the flamethrower on her back, Kate rises to her feet.
us.zh_draft: 凱特揹著火焰噴射器站起身。
us.zh: 凱特揹著火焰噴射器站起身。

us.en: She shoots a blast at the creature
us.zh_draft: 她朝怪物噴出一道火焰，
us.zh: 她朝怪物噴出一道火焰，

us.en: as it drags Adam out of the room.
us.zh_draft: 怪物正把亞當拖出房間。
us.zh: 怪物正把亞當拖出房間。

us.en: She follows it through the doorway,
then searches the hall.

uk.en: Kate turns to Carter.
uk.zh_draft: 凱特轉向卡特。
uk.zh: 凱特轉向卡特。

uk.en: Kate takes a seat
uk.zh_draft: 凱特坐下，
uk.zh: 凱特坐下，

uk.en: as Colin and Jonas help Edvard to the couch.
uk.zh_draft: 柯林和喬納斯扶艾德華到沙發上。
uk.zh: 柯林和喬納斯扶艾德華到沙發上。

uk.en: Suddenly, his left arm detaches itself from the body.
uk.zh_draft: 突然，他的左臂從身體脫落。
uk.zh: 突然，他的左臂從身體脫落。

uk.en: Sprouting legs and tentacles, the arm clings to Jonas
uk.zh_draft: 那隻手臂長出腳和觸手，緊抓住喬納斯，
uk.zh: 那隻手臂長出腳和觸手，緊抓住喬納斯，

uk.en: and tries to attack his face.
uk.zh_draft: 想攻擊他的臉。
uk.zh: 想攻擊他的臉。

uk.en: Jonas grapples with a mutating limb.
uk.zh_draft: 喬納斯和不斷變異的肢體扭打。
uk.zh: 喬納斯和不斷變異的肢體扭打。

uk.en: Jonas backs over to a bookcase.
uk.zh_draft: 喬納斯退到書櫃旁。
uk.zh: 喬納斯退到書櫃旁。

uk.en: A mouth opens within the severed stump
uk.zh_draft: 斷肢裡張開一張嘴，
uk.zh: 斷肢裡張開一張嘴，

uk.en: and using tentacles, it clamps itself over Jonas's mouth.
uk.zh_draft: 用觸手把自己緊緊扣在喬納斯嘴上。
uk.zh: 用觸手把自己緊緊扣在喬納斯嘴上。

uk.en: It forces something down his gullet.
uk.zh_draft: 它把某種東西硬塞進他的喉嚨。
uk.zh: 它把某種東西硬塞進他的喉嚨。

uk.en: Edvard's body begins to convulse.
uk.zh_draft: 艾德華的身體開始抽搐。
uk.zh: 艾德華的身體開始抽搐。

uk.en: Carter makes to torch it,
uk.zh_draft: 卡特想用火燒它，
uk.zh: 卡特想用火燒它，

uk.en: but the flamethrower fails.
uk.zh_draft: 但火焰噴射器失靈。
uk.zh: 但火焰噴射器失靈。

uk.en: A large pink tentacle erupts out of Edvard's chest
uk.zh_draft: 一條粗大的粉紅觸手從艾德華胸口爆出，
uk.zh: 一條粗大的粉紅觸手從艾德華胸口爆出，

uk.en: and flares around the room.
uk.zh_draft: 在房間裡四處亂甩。
uk.zh: 在房間裡四處亂甩。

uk.en: Adam ducks,
uk.zh_draft: 亞當低頭閃躲，
uk.zh: 亞當低頭閃躲，

uk.en: then picks himself up off the floor
uk.zh_draft: 接著從地上爬起來，
uk.zh: 接著從地上爬起來，

uk.en: and makes a run for it.
uk.zh_draft: 拔腿就跑。
uk.zh: 拔腿就跑。

uk.en: He trips and falls.
uk.zh_draft: 他絆倒在地。
uk.zh: 他絆倒在地。

uk.en: The tentacle rips a hole in his abdomen.
uk.zh_draft: 觸手在他腹部撕開一個洞。
uk.zh: 觸手在他腹部撕開一個洞。

uk.en: Carter and Jameson overturn the pool table for cover.
uk.zh_draft: 卡特和詹姆森翻倒撞球桌當掩護。
uk.zh: 卡特和詹姆森翻倒撞球桌當掩護。

uk.en: The tentacle punches through the table,
uk.zh_draft: 觸手擊穿桌子，
uk.zh: 觸手擊穿桌子，

uk.en: knocking Carter over.
uk.zh_draft: 把卡特撞倒。
uk.zh: 把卡特撞倒。

uk.en: Jameson jumps up
uk.zh_draft: 詹姆森跳起來，
uk.zh: 詹姆森跳起來，

uk.en: and shoots at Edvard.
uk.zh_draft: 朝艾德華開槍。
uk.zh: 朝艾德華開槍。

uk.en: The tentacle whips at Jameson
uk.zh_draft: 觸手甩向詹姆森，
uk.zh: 觸手甩向詹姆森，

uk.en: and punches a hole in his chest.
uk.zh_draft: 在他胸口打穿一個洞。
uk.zh: 在他胸口打穿一個洞。

uk.en: He collapses.
uk.zh_draft: 他倒了下去。
uk.zh: 他倒了下去。

uk.en: As Carter tends to Jameson,
uk.zh_draft: 卡特照料詹姆森的同時，
uk.zh: 卡特照料詹姆森的同時，

uk.en: Kate tries to get the flamethrower going again.
uk.zh_draft: 凱特試著讓火焰噴射器重新運作。
uk.zh: 凱特試著讓火焰噴射器重新運作。

uk.en: The alien turns its attention back to Adam,
uk.zh_draft: 異形把注意力轉回亞當身上，
uk.zh: 異形把注意力轉回亞當身上，

uk.en: who's severely wounded and trying to back away from it.
uk.zh_draft: 亞當身受重傷，正努力往後退。
uk.zh: 亞當身受重傷，正努力往後退。

uk.en: Edvard's right arm breaks off
uk.zh_draft: 艾德華的右臂斷落，
uk.zh: 艾德華的右臂斷落，

uk.en: and runs away on spindly legs.
uk.zh_draft: 用細長的腳逃走。
uk.zh: 用細長的腳逃走。

uk.en: The rest of the body continues to mutate,
uk.zh_draft: 身體其餘部分持續變異，
uk.zh: 身體其餘部分持續變異，

uk.en: sprouting pink and glistening insect-like limbs.
uk.zh_draft: 長出粉紅發亮、像昆蟲般的肢體。
uk.zh: 長出粉紅發亮、像昆蟲般的肢體。

uk.en: It crawls towards Adam.
uk.zh_draft: 它爬向亞當。
uk.zh: 它爬向亞當。

uk.en: The nightmare creature lowers itself on top of him,
uk.zh_draft: 這隻夢魘般的怪物壓到他身上，
uk.zh: 這隻夢魘般的怪物壓到他身上，

uk.en: and pushes Edvard's pulsating face towards his.
uk.zh_draft: 把艾德華不斷搏動的臉推向他的臉。
uk.zh: 把艾德華不斷搏動的臉推向他的臉。

uk.en: It rubs Edvard's face against Adam's,
uk.zh_draft: 它把艾德華的臉在亞當臉上摩擦，
uk.zh: 它把艾德華的臉在亞當臉上摩擦，

uk.en: and the two fuse together like conjoined Siamese twins.
uk.zh_draft: 兩張臉像連體嬰一樣融合在一起。
uk.zh: 兩張臉像連體嬰一樣融合在一起。

uk.en: Kate gets the flamethrower going
uk.zh_draft: 凱特讓火焰噴射器重新噴火，
uk.zh: 凱特讓火焰噴射器重新噴火，

uk.en: and breaks cover
uk.zh_draft: 從掩護後衝出，
uk.zh: 從掩護後衝出，

uk.en: just as the now combined alien and Adam scuttles out of the room.
uk.zh_draft: 這時已和亞當合體的異形正急急竄出房間。
uk.zh: 這時已和亞當合體的異形正急急竄出房間。
